# Proverbs 31 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 31:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | What, my-son? And-what, son-of my-womb? And-what, son-of my-vows? |
| LOGOS | What are you doing, my son? What are you doing, son of my womb? What are you doing, son of my vows? |
| PNEUMA | Listen to me, my son! You are the child I carried. You are the answer to my prayers. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| EMET | Do-not-give to-women your-strength, and-your-ways to-those-who-destroy kings. |
| LOGOS | Do not give your strength to women, your ways to those who destroy kings. |
| PNEUMA | Don't waste your strength on women, and don't let your lifestyle destroy your leadership. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| LOGOS | Lest they drink and forget what has been decreed and pervert the rights of all the afflicted. |
| PNEUMA | Because drinking makes them forget the law and take away the rights of the vulnerable. |
